 Room Attendant - Hotel Rooms (Day Shifts) | 5-star hotel - Kaatsheuvel (Tilburg/Waalwijk region) - The Keepers - 2 weken geleden 
You start your shift while the day begins. Guests have checked out, and you prepare rooms so new guests can arrive in a clean and well-prepared space. Fresh beds, everything in place. 
About the location 
You'll work in a newly opened 5-star hotel in Kaatsheuvel, in the Tilburg/Waalwijk region. Everything is new, from the rooms to the design. 
Guests are mainly families. You'll be part of an international team where English is the main language. 
The role 
You work daytime shifts from 10:00 to 15:30. You prepare rooms within a clear schedule, with time pressure between check-out and check-in. The workload is more manageable compared to large city hotels. 
You'll be trained on the job and gradually work independently. Quality is checked by a supervisor. 
What will you do? - Clean hotel rooms - Change and make beds - Prepare rooms for new guests - Perform stayover service - Check rooms for quality - Report issues - Assist guests if needed 
Who are we looking for? - You speak Dutch and/or English - You are available at least 16 hours per week - You can work weekends and holidays - You work accurately and independently - Experience is a plus, motivation is more important 
What do we offer? - €17.67 per hour (including holiday pay and vacation days) - Travel allowance of €0.23 per km - Day shifts from 10:00 to 15:30 - Flexible planning - 13th month bonus (paid in December) - Temporary contract - Possibility of a direct contract over time - With consistent availability: chance to receive a subscription 
Closing 
This role fits if you want to work during the day or combine it with other activities.
